senses.definition: A moderate degree of heat; the sensation of being warm.

quotes.text: Included in the crowd of more than 10,000 was a gay contingent of over 100. A large banner proclaiming "Gay American Revolution" beckoned other gay marchers to join the contingent. Several participants said that they were pleased with the noticeable warmth of the other demonstrators toward the gay people.
quotes.reference: 1973 December 22, “Boston Tea Party”, in Gay Community News, volume 1, number 27, page 1:

senses.definition: Fervor, intensity of emotion or expression.

quotes.text: "You don't know him—don't pronounce an opinion upon him," I said with warmth.
